prompts.Reference:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original RPG character identity reference and transparent full-body idle artwork, Adventure World 2, spiritId aw2-than, art variant base-v1.
Primary request: Create ONE original Vietnamese-inspired human food-memory spirit called Than, a compact sturdy androgynous young adult tank guardian, warm thoughtful face, short dark slightly tousled hair, rolled indigo cotton sleeves, cream inner shirt, charcoal trousers, worn cloth gloves, simple practical sandals. Holds ONE broad rounded stove-lid-inspired bronze shield with three small ember-red inlays and a cloth-wrapped handle, no weapon, no stove/food head. Shield is on their own left forearm, right gloved hand relaxed. Gentle grounded protective character; proportioned HD anime game art, about 5.5 heads tall, not a child.
Composition: single complete body, three-quarter front view facing slightly screen-right, steady neutral idle, both feet fully visible, shield in full view, all within canvas with 10 percent transparent padding, foot baseline at 90 percent canvas height.
Style: original clean HD anime illustration, precise ink contours, restrained painted cel shading, readable game silhouette, warm ember/copper accents on deep indigo. No visual references to any existing franchise or artist.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha. No floor or environment, no cast shadow beyond silhouette, no border, text, labels, logo or watermark. Do not add companions, scenery or multiple poses. The character and shield form a single coherent cutout.
prompts.World:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original pixel/chibi WORLD sprite sheet for Adventure World 2, aw2-than base-v1.
Input image 1 is the identity reference ONLY. Keep the same short dark tousled hair, warm face, rolled indigo sleeves, cream shirt, cloth gloves, charcoal trousers/sandals, round bronze stove-lid shield with three ember-red accents on character's LEFT forearm. No new accessory.
Create one precise uniform 4-column x 4-row sprite atlas on a square canvas. EXACTLY 16 separate full-body sprites, one sprite per equal square cell. No grid lines, no text or labels. True transparent background, no scenery/shadows/checkerboard.
Rows from top to bottom: row1 facing DOWN/front, row2 facing LEFT/profile, row3 facing RIGHT/profile, row4 facing UP/back. Show back of head/clothing in row4, no face looking backward. Every sprite faces the specified direction. Do not mirror the asymmetrical shield onto the wrong arm.
Columns left to right in EVERY row: standing idle; walking with left foot forward; passing stride with feet centered; walking with right foot forward. Four visibly different authored frames per direction, stable proportions/silhouette and no extra limbs.
Style: crisp actual pixel art, compact chibi guardian about 3 heads tall, restrained indigo/cream/bronze/ember palette, clearly pixelated hard-edged clusters, no smooth anime rendering. Character fits within central 65 percent width and 75 percent height of each cell, feet baseline 88 percent down each cell; keep shield, hair, toes entirely within the cell, generous transparent gutters. All cells same size and scale. No portraits, duplicates outside grid, decorative borders, watermarks or logos.
prompts.Battle:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original transparent HD anime BATTLE key-pose atlas, Adventure World 2, aw2-than base-v1. Input image 1 is the identity reference only: same adult guardian, dark tousled short hair, rolled indigo sleeves, cream shirt, cloth gloves, charcoal trousers, sandals and round bronze stove-lid shield with three ember inlays on their LEFT forearm.
Create EXACTLY 8 complete-body poses on ONE square canvas, uniform 4 columns x 2 rows, 8 equal rectangular cells, no text/grid/border. Each cell width is one quarter canvas, height one half. One figure per cell. All figures at the SAME SCALE with generous transparent space. All but defeat stand at foot baseline 90 percent cell height; all body parts, shield and VFX fit completely inside their own cell.
Row1 left to right: (1) IDLE relaxed protective neutral three-quarter facing screen-right; (2) MOVE purposeful forward stride screen-right, free arm swinging, shield steady; (3) ATTACK right gloved hand striking forward in a short heavy punch with shield held back, body clearly lunging; (4) CAST planting shield down and right hand cupping a small ember to begin protection.
Row2 left to right: (5) HIT recoil chest/shoulder backwards, pained face, knees bent, shield knocked aside but held; (6) GUARD low braced stance, shield raised in front covering torso, eyes over rim; (7) ULTIMATE wide grounded stance, shield lifted protectively outward, free hand open behind signaling allies to shelter, small controlled ember rim glow only, no huge arc spilling out; (8) DEFEAT kneeling/collapsed safely on one side with shield resting beside them, exhausted, no gore.
Style: proportioned HD anime game illustration, crisp original ink and cel shading like reference, NOT chibi/pixel. Same costume and face in all 8. Every pose visibly distinct; no substitution of an idle portrait for a state. Do not mirror shield arm between poses. Background truly transparent alpha; no scenery/floor/ground shadows. No label, word, number, logo, watermark, grid line, additional person, weapons or cropped feet.

Change ONLY the pose layout/spacing and scale; keep same character, face, costume, shield identity, original art style, pose semantics.
Critical repair: every one of 8 figures MUST be fully inside its equal atlas cell with WIDE transparent gutters on all sides. Four columns by two rows, exactly 8 figures. Keep each figure and all glow inside the central 70 percent of its cell WIDTH and central 82 percent of cell HEIGHT. No hands, shield, toes, hair, particle or glow may cross these corridors. Same body scale across all poses, stable foot baseline at 90% each cell height; defeat may sit lower.
Row1: idle, move, punch attack, ember cast. Row2: hit recoil, shield guard, protective ultimate open hand, kneeling defeat. Keep distinct poses, same shield arm.
True transparent alpha background with no floor/shadows; no labels, grid, borders, text, logos, extra people or duplicated poses. Prefer smaller complete bodies with more space over large clipped art.

prompts.Fx:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent sprite VFX atlas for original Adventure World 2 guardian aw2-than; no character body in this asset.
Create EXACT 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 isolated original hand-painted anime game effect decals in equal square cells, square canvas. Transparent alpha background (no black/gray rectangle, no ground, no checkerboard), wide gutters separating all cells. Each effect wholly inside central 65 percent width/height of its own cell; NOTHING crosses cell edges. No letters, numbers, labels, grid lines, watermark or logo.
Row1: Gõ Bếp melee contact impact, 4 successive stages left-to-right: tiny bronze/ember point, compact sharp orange-copper impact burst, wider short bent ember sparks, fading few sparks. No projectile/traveling fireball.
Row2: Giữ Lửa shield cast, 4 stages: warm bronze outline of a small rounded stove-lid shield, forming translucent indigo shield face with three ember dots, stable glowing bronze/indigo shield emblem, fading shield outline.
Row3: Than Còn Ấm passive proc, 4 stages: one ember, three small separated warm embers rising in a compact spiral, three clear glowing embers with restrained trail, embers fading away. Visually SMALLER/softer than impact.
Row4: Chỗ Sau Lưng ultimate protection, 4 stages: forming broad bronze/ember protective arch open at its bottom, fuller curved half-dome arch with indigo translucent protective fill, complete readable protective half-dome with three ember inlays, arch fading into soft sparks. No screen-wide explosion, no ritual text, no copied icon.
Restrained copper/ember red/deep indigo palette. Clearly distinct silhouettes per skill, legible against light and dark game backgrounds, no enormous bloom; clean cutout alpha outside each effect.
prompts.FxRepair:

NO smoke, NO bloom, NO fog, NO broad red haze, NO scenery, NO black rectangles or ground shadows, NO labels or grid.
